title: Acquire only the structure forced by actual input effects
statement: For D=F1+F0 and Delta_h G(s)=G(s+h)+G(s), the reported exact acquisition grows a span with witnessed D(s) and Delta_h F0(s) outside the current span, including newly acquired basis tasks. Every acquired direction is forced into every closed candidate, yielding the unique least H_star. Admission additionally checks Delta_h D=0 and Delta_h Delta_v F0=Delta_h Delta_v O=0 globally. Successful k-dimensional acquisition needs1+3k+choose(k,2)SAT queries of polynomial circuit size. This is a query bound, not an efficient SAT/proof solver or a reachable-state-only result.

assumptions: The identities hold for ALL original states, including unreachable ones. SAT/proof queries and their potentially exponential cost are acquisition resources, not a polynomial-time theorem. Rejection excludes only this fixed global translation class. After admission, constraints must be input/output bit assignments or affine parity equations; arbitrary Boolean conditions and biased weighted counting are not supplied. One nonlinear zero-input baseline still costs work linear in the requested horizon, with growing input-coefficient bit costs. A conventional affine symbolic method won the supplied main timing example. No useful-workload advantage, external novelty, general circuit-counting result or P-versus-NP consequence is established. Only the visible prefix/overlapping tail and links are acquired; no P3 raw export or alternate transfer is made.
